fragments.body:
`pose assess discover`, `pose assess integrate` and `pose assess tech-debt`
now derive project identity, topology, contracts, gaps and debt coverage from
the selected repository instead of shipping producer-project names and static
conclusions. Scans are root-confined and bounded, exclude generated/test/build
evidence where applicable, recognize Protobuf, REST/OpenAPI, message and MCP
observations, and update project-state from the persisted assessment results.
